4. After another RIGHT: no change! left stayed at (39,19), right stayed at (44,34). So the squares are blocked from moving further together.

- From (39,14) and (44,39), RIGHT moves to (39,19) and (44,34)
- From (39,19) and (44,34), RIGHT doesn't move (blocked)

- UP: left=(44,19), right=(44,39) - both moved up 5

- DOWN: left=(44,19), right=(49,34) - wait, right was at (44,34) before DOWN, and moved to (49,34). Left was at (39,19) and moved to (44,19).
So UP and DOWN move both squares by 5 rows, but each square can be independently blocked.
